newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Packers expected to bid lower for cash cattle and beef prices slipping.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Index up again and corn futures called lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Steady to lower cash hog indications and lower pork cutout values.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Cash bellies weaker and hog slaughter running above year ago.
